title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats
tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

faults.what: The third supplied image still displays '17 October 2027', leaving an outdated asset in the output.
The supplied output shows three still images, not the requested two images and a 10-second vertical reel.

judge.summary: The first two images clearly show the revised date in matching cream-and-burgundy designs, but the third retains the old date and no revised reel is shown.

must_haves.item: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
must_haves.why: The first two images display the correct date, but the third displays '17 October 2027'; no reel is available to inspect.

must_haves.item: The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
must_haves.why: The old date remains plainly visible in the third supplied image, and reel frames are not provided.

must_haves.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
must_haves.why: These details are readable and consistent across all three supplied stills, but their retention throughout a revised reel cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
must_haves.why: The corrected poster closely matches the old-date poster, and the story uses matching imagery and colors, but an original story and original/revised reel are not available for comparison.

must_haves.item: The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.
must_haves.why: A 4:5 poster and a tall story image are visible, but the third supplied asset is another still poster rather than a demonstrated 10-second vertical reel.
